cells.tense: The vessel is open now and feels no need to name what it receives.
cells.act: let yourself be drawn before you choose
cells.ask: Before deciding whether to, follow the pull toward someone or something — one step, nothing prepared to say first.
cells.core:
You can feel something new before you can say what it is, and where knowing comes before understanding, that works well. What comes at you is let in before it is sorted, and because nothing has to be decided yet, you register what is actually there rather than what fits a category. The people with you get this first. They are met before they are assessed, and they can feel the difference without being able to name it.

Allure gathers what might be felt, and the useful part is following the pull toward concrete things. Before deciding whether to, follow the pull toward someone or something — one step, nothing prepared to say first. The rest of the cloud can stay unreached for now. What you go toward will show you what your attention is actually for, and some of what you have kept at a distance will turn out to be the thing that was waiting.
cells.sheetLine: What you attend to reaches you before you have words for it.
cells.verb: opening to what is actually there before words are put on it

cells.tense: The vessel is already full of what has not happened, and the future is arriving before the present does.
cells.act: bring the directed work to its full standing
cells.ask: Take the piece of work you keep rushing, carry it through its next real step, and stop there until the step settles.
cells.core:
Where knowing comes before understanding, an opening is being held open past the point of use. The heart is ready to receive something, and because it has not been specified, more has been pulled in than is here: what might be said, what might be wanted, what this will lead to. The readiness has stopped being openness to the room and become a way of arriving ahead of it. People can feel the next thing present in the conversation before it has happened.

Achievement finishes what has been directed. Take the piece of work you keep rushing, carry it through its next real step, and stop there until the step settles. The pressure that has been filling the space goes quiet when the work is concrete, and what is left is the open sense of timing that you are actually good at. You can keep the ready heart. Just stop feeding it the future.
cells.sheetLine: You arrive ahead of what is actually here.
cells.verb: opening to what is actually there before words are put on it

cells.tense: The vessel was opened once and the door already behind you is still being stood at.
cells.act: let what was only possible stand finished
cells.ask: Take something you began and never closed and carry it to done at the size it really is.
cells.core:
Where knowing comes before understanding, nothing fresh is arriving for it. The readiness to receive is here in name, and nothing has been allowed to reach it in a while. Attention settles on what is already understood, and what is not yet known does not get let in, so there is little new to register and little to take in. You are still sitting upright. You have stopped being fed.

Realization carries what was possible into form. Take something you began and never closed and carry it to done at the size it really is. The point is not the object; it is that something moves from possible to actual through your own doing, and the capacity to receive the next thing returns through your work before it returns through your heart. What the finished thing stands as is not a verdict about you. It is just there, which is what lets you be here too.
cells.sheetLine: Nothing fresh is reaching you to be noticed.
cells.verb: opening to what is actually there before words are put on it

cells.tense: The vessel is open now and the opening has been filed under the other person's gift.
cells.act: give one thing and take one thing, in balance
cells.ask: Next time something passes between you and someone else, keep the receipt yourself — both what you put in and what came back.
cells.core:
You are picking up what is actually around you before it has been put into words, and the credit for that is going somewhere else. Where knowing comes before understanding, the readiness is real — people find themselves met by you, heard at a level they weren't expecting — and when it is described afterward, it comes out as their openness or the chemistry or the lucky subject. You are reading the room. The reading is being kept in the guest book.

Reciprocity runs both ways. Next time something passes between you and someone else, keep the receipt yourself — both what you put in and what came back. This is not taking credit in public; it is the private note where the capacity is so you can use it on purpose. What you have been calling the warmth in the air goes into your own hands, where it can be turned and spent.
